cohort: A 34-year-old multiparous woman who presented with a painful nodule at a scar site, five years after her last of two emergency caesarean sections.
finding: Painful lumps at surgical scars, particularly after obstetric surgery, should raise suspicion of scar endometriosis, necessitating proper preoperative workup with imaging modalities like USG and MRI to assess disease extent and plan surgical treatment.
mod_finding: Scar endometriosis can develop following caesarean sections, presenting as a painful nodule at the surgical scar.
